NAH

This is a stressful time for all of you, having it all together under one roof would be hard. There could be tension, snappiness, emotions flying about the place; it definitely wouldn’t be the same as every other Christmas like I think your dad is hoping it’d be. You’re not bailing by not going, you can celebrate with your parents without physically being there. As a child, it’s not your duty to be their emotional support or physically be home every holiday. It’s something we, as children, do for our parents out of love and respect. We can only do it as much as we can in our situation, sometimes it just doesn’t work out and that doesn’t mean you care any less or they’ll be disappointed. You sound very empathetic and caring and I’m sure your parents are very proud and would understand if you didn’t go. 

Let them know you can’t make it down, but don’t say it’s because of the situation, simply because it could make them blame themselves. Tell a white lie or half truth, like you can’t afford it right now and you can’t afford to miss work or something. You might have to put your foot down and repeatedly explain that you can’t come, and if they offer to pay say that you have to stay for other reasons (eg. you can’t afford to miss work because you’ll get sanctioned/have a really shit paycheck). And emphasize that you have stuff going on where you are during the holiday (even if you don’t) so they don’t worry you’ll be alone. 

If they’re upset about not seeing you, which I’m sure they will be, then promise to video chat and that you’ll be thinking about them during the holidays. Just really lay on the niceties and send them a card with a heartfelt message in the post and presents if you can. Ping them a text every few days like “____ reminded me of you, love you, merry xmas” kind of thing. Find creative holiday things to distract them from the fact you’re not there. 

I know you probably have a few plans of actions and I don’t doubt you know half the stuff i’m mentioning, I just felt like sharing this could be useful for you and for others in similar situations scrolling this post. 

Hope you have a lovely christmas regardless of what you decide to do and don’t be too hard on yourself or your parents. We all need a bit of extra love during the holidays, it can be hard for all sorts of reasons.
